test_decisions.scenario: HTTP 403 and 404 are explicit failures; unrecognized status also fails; stdout success remains parseable; secret-bearing CLI stderr and query values are never logged.
test_decisions.requirement: R127-02 and R127-07: authorization and GitHub transport failure should remain fail-closed and avoid secret disclosure.

search.scope: Reused established API transport and its existing runner test suite; no new alternate API implementation.

candidates.oracle: Valid JSON is returned when authenticated gh command exits successfully; failure cases reject while showing status only.
candidates.comparison: Extend existing runner module with a positive and three negative scenarios rather than creating a second suite.

candidates.oracle: The pre-existing policy unit suite checks authorization and assurance, not HTTP transport error behavior.
candidates.comparison: Keep existing policy checks and add transport-specific cases in existing runner module.

test_decisions.justification: An existing integration-level module already exercises GitHub API transport; extend it and preserve existing negative identity controls.

search.scope: Reused current trusted publisher and existing publication tests; extended to authenticated main base resolution.
